name: EPIC 248863593

text.card: A red giant 3,846 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.32 solar masses and 14.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,965 K at its surface.
